overview: The use-bed packet has a single corpus hit: Artemis registers a GPacketPlayServerBed wrapper that decodes the player id and bed BlockPos. No check consumes it. The packet is a clientbound pose broadcast with no timing, position or state claim a server-side anticheat could measure, so the ecosystem ignores it.

checks.name: Packet wrapper registration (Artemis)
checks.purpose: Register the use-bed packet in Artemis's packet abstraction so the wrapper tree recognizes clientbound bed traffic.
checks.how_it_works: GPacketPlayServerBed extends GPacket, links to PacketPlayServerBed, and its read() decodes the player id as a VarInt and the bed position as a packed BlockPos. No check in the corpus consumes these fields.
checks.detects: Nothing. The entry documents the only corpus touch point for S0A: wrapper plumbing, not detection logic.
checks.variations: No other anticheat references S0APacketUseBed or PacketPlayOutBed.
